title: Hellrider Platoon
html:
Hellrider Platoon is a unique class action only available during the Confront the Elder Brain quest. It allows the party to summon a Hellrider Paladin and Hellrider Cleric along with Zevlor to aid them in the final battle.

Description

Summon Zevlor's Hellriders to  Smite foes and support frontline allies.

Dismissed after combat until re-summoned.
Can't be summoned again if killed in combat.
